$comment: Tier 3 weights, bands and policy knobs (SPEC §6, §13). Hot-tunable: THRESHOLDS_PATH points here. Hand-tuned now; train-classifier.ts refines at build step 7.

weights.$comment: The w1..w11 of the SPEC §6 scoring equation.

safetyWeights.$comment: Safety is scored separately from contact: it must not be relaxed post-booking.

modifiers.$comment: stageModifier: post_booking massively relaxes CONTACT rules only (host must share address/gate code). roleModifier: a host pushing off-platform is worse than a guest (fraud asymmetry).

bands.$comment: score < low -> allow | > high -> block | between -> Tier 4. Target: >=92% of traffic decided at or before Tier 3 (SPEC §6).

policy.$comment: SPEC §9 rate limiting; wired fully at build step 9.

failMode.$comment: SPEC §2: pre_booking fails CLOSED, post_booking fails OPEN.
